summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Planet Transfers airport booking service. Backend APIs 100% functional, frontend UI working with minor button overlay issue on homepage form.

ui_bugs.issue: Continue button has overlay interception issue preventing normal click
ui_bugs.workaround: Force click with force=True works, form submission via Enter key also works

passed_tests: Route prices seeding and retrieval (7 routes)
Quote generation (£45.00 for economy London route)
Homepage loading with hero section and booking widget
Navigation to booking page with form data
Vehicle selection page (4 vehicle types with prices)
Passenger info form with all fields
Review & pay page with correct summary and £45.00 price
Admin dashboard with bookings and route prices tabs
Admin route management (add/edit routes via modal)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix continue button overlay issue on homepage booking form - element interception preventing normal clicks. Consider adjusting z-index or click event handling.
success_percentage: Backend: 100% (14/14 tests passed), Frontend: 95% (1 minor UI issue)
